entry.title: E-2026-002 Eighteen more pages map only some of the candidates on the ballot
entry.summary: Open. According to Ballotpedia, these pages show two candidates while more were on the ballot. Senate: Georgia, Texas, Nebraska, North Carolina, Kentucky, Michigan, Arkansas, Oklahoma, Florida, Iowa and Idaho. Governor: Arizona, Michigan, Nevada, Ohio, Wisconsin, Pennsylvania and Arkansas. Shares on these pages are shares of the two shown candidates, not of all votes. California is complete (top-two race). Iowa governor is unresolved because Ballotpedia pages disagree. About 30 other pages have not been checked yet.

entry.title: E-2026-001 Montana Senate map shows two of the candidates on the ballot
entry.summary: Disclosed on page. The page maps Seth Bodnar (independent) and Kurt Alme (Republican) only. It leaves out Democrat Alani Bankhead, Libertarian Kyle Austin and one write-in candidate. The headline share is therefore a share of the two shown candidates' votes, not of all votes.
